title: HumanCentric-Scenes-AI: A Human-Curated Multimodal Dataset of AI-Generated Human-Centric Scenes Across Surveillance, Occupational Portraits, AI-Edited Images, and Short-Form Video
abstract: arXiv:2610.29045v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce HumanCentric-Scenes-AI, a human-curated dataset of 296 AI-generated stimuli that depict people across four contexts in which people encounter AI-generated media. The Surveillance subset contains 85 AI-generated CCTV-style images. The Occupations subset contains 128 AI-generated occupational portraits in a balanced paired design covering 64 occupations with one female and one male version of each. The AI-edited subset contains 27 real photographs in which a region was altered or replaced by a generative model. The Video subset contains 56 AI-generated short videos. We curated the images and videos manually over multiple rounds to make them as photorealistic as possible. For each stimulus we release the file, the generation prompt where recorded, and per-stimulus metadata. translated_title: HumanCentric-Scenes-AI：一个由人工整理的多模态数据集，涵盖监控场景、职业肖像、AI编辑图像和短视频中的AI生成人物场景
translated_abstract: 我们推出了HumanCentric-Scenes-AI，这是一个由人工整理的数据集，包含296个AI生成的刺激材料，描绘了人们在四种接触AI生成媒体的情境中的人物形象。监控子集包含85张AI生成的监控摄像头风格图像。职业子集包含128张AI生成的职业肖像，采用平衡配对设计，涵盖64种职业，每种职业各有一个女性版本和一个男性版本。AI编辑子集包含27张真实照片，其中某个区域被生成模型修改或替换。视频子集包含56个AI生成的短视频。我们通过多轮人工整理这些图像和视频，使其尽可能逼真。对于每个刺激材料，我们发布了文件本身、记录的生成提示词（如有）以及每个刺激的元数据。我们报告了最初134个未指定性别的生成结果中人物性别分布情况，并将其与美国劳工统计局的数据进行了比较（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文贡献了一个由人工精心整理的多模态数据集，包含296个AI生成的人物刺激材料，涵盖监控图像、性别平衡配对的职业肖像、AI编辑照片和短视频四种情境，可用于研究人们对AI生成媒体的感知。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a human-curated multimodal dataset of 296 AI-generated human-centric stimuli across four contexts—surveillance imagery, gender-balanced occupational portraits, AI-edited photos, and short-form videos—for studying perception of AI-generated media.
